# Niltavi UI source

The product components in this directory and the files in [src/theme](../../theme) are copied from [Niltavi UI at e02d250](https://github.com/niltavi/niltavi-ui/tree/e02d250798185d7e84214ef06596482cc00ad898). The wordmark assets in [public](../../../public) match that revision. Update the component and theme files together when changing the pin.

The [MIT license](../../../public/licenses/niltavi-ui.txt) and [DM Sans font license](../../../public/licenses/dm-sans.txt) are served with the built site.
